name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off.
usageSnippet: <ToggleGroup items=[{ value: "left", label: "Left" }, { value: "center", label: "Center" }] value=["center"]/>

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial selected value of the toggle group when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the selected value of the toggle group.

props.name: deselectable
props.description:
Whether the toggle group allows empty selection.
**Note:** This is ignored if `multiple` is `true`.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the toggle. Useful for composition.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether to loop focus inside the toggle group.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether to allow multiple toggles to be selected.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the toggle group.

props.name: rovingFocus
props.description: Whether to use roving tab index to manage focus.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled selected value of the toggle group.

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Function to call when the toggle is clicked.

keyboard.description: Moves focus into and out of the group, landing on the currently pressed item (or the first item if none is pressed).
Moves focus between items when `orientation` is `horizontal` (the default); wraps at the ends.
Moves focus between items when `orientation="vertical"`; wraps at the ends.
Moves focus to the first / last item.

accessibilityNotes: The root renders `role="group"`; each item is a native `<button type="button">` with `aria-pressed` reflecting its toggled state, so assistive tech announces the set and each item's state without extra ARIA wiring.

Use `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` on `ToggleGroup` to give the group an accessible name, especially when it has no visible heading (the font-weight-selector example instead pairs it with a visible `FieldLabel`).

Icon-only items need their own accessible name. A per-item `<@item>` forwards `value`/`disabled`/`content` (and an `items=` entry adds `label`) — there is no per-item `aria-label` passthrough, and the item button does not receive one — so an icon-only item must carry a visually-hidden label in its content (see toggle-group-vertical.marko).
Disabling `ToggleGroup` itself (not a single item) removes every item from the tab order and blocks pointer input across the whole group.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Pass an `items: { value, label, disabled? }[]` array and the component renders every item internally — or compose items in markup with `<@item>` attribute tags (see the Compound example). By default only one item can be pressed at a time.

examples.title: Multiple selection
examples.description: Pass `multiple` to allow more than one item to be pressed at once.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import ToggleGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toggle-group/toggle-group.marko"; static const ALIGNMENT = [ { value: "left", label: "Left" }, { value: "center", label: "Center" }, { value: "right", label: "Right" }, ];
{ value = next; } /> value: ${value.join(", ") || "none"}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `value:=state`.

examples.title: Compound (attr tags)
examples.source:
import ToggleGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toggle-group/toggle-group.marko";

<ToggleGroup value=["center"]>
  <@item value="left">Left</@item>
  <@item value="center">Center</@item>
  <@item value="right">Right</@item>
</ToggleGroup>
examples.description: Use `<@item>` attribute tags instead of `items=` to compose each option directly in markup.

examples.title: Outline
Size
examples.source: import ToggleGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toggle-group/toggle-group.marko"; static const ALIGNMENT = [ { value: "left", label: "Left" }, { value: "center", label: "Center" }, { value: "right", label: "Right" }, ];
examples.description: Pass `size` as `sm`, `default`, or `lg` to change the size of every item.

examples.title: Spacing
examples.description: Pass `spacing` (in Tailwind spacing-scale units) to add gap between items — `spacing={0}` renders connected items with shared borders instead.

examples.title: Vertical
examples.source: import ToggleGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toggle-group/toggle-group.marko"; import Icon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/icon/icon.marko"; <@item value="bold"> Bold <@item value="italic"> Italic <@item value="underline"> Underline
examples.description: Pass `orientation="vertical"` for a vertical toggle group; arrow-key navigation follows the same axis.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Pass `disabled` on `ToggleGroup` to disable every item in the group.

examples.title: Custom
examples.source: import ToggleGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toggle-group/toggle-group.marko"; import Field from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field.marko"; import FieldLabel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-label.marko"; import FieldDescription from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-description.marko"; Font Weight { fontWeight = next[0] ?? fontWeight; } variant="outline" spacing=2 size="lg" > <@item value="light"> Aa Light <@item value="normal"> Aa Normal <@item value="medium"> Aa Medium <@item value="bold"> Aa Bold Use font-${fontWeight} to set the font weight.
examples.description: A custom toggle group example: `<@item>` bodies can render arbitrary markup (not just text), here paired with `Field`/`FieldLabel`/`FieldDescription` to build a font-weight selector.

examples.title: RTL
examples.source:
import ToggleGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toggle-group/toggle-group.marko";

<ToggleGroup variant="outline" value=["list"] dir="rtl">
  <@item value="list">قائمة</@item>
  <@item value="grid">شبكة</@item>
  <@item value="cards">بطاقات</@item>
</ToggleGroup>
examples.description: Toggle groups restyle correctly under `dir="rtl"` — the same prop drives both the machine's arrow-key navigation direction and the logical-property layout, so pass it straight to `ToggleGroup` rather than only wrapping it in a `dir` attribute.

composition:
A single-file component whose anatomy is expressed through the `items=` array or `<@item>` attribute tags, not separate parts — api-reference.json sees one part, so this prose stands in for upstream's Composition tree:

```text
ToggleGroup
└── item (one per entry in `items=`, or one per `<@item>` attribute tag)
```

Upstream expresses this as `ToggleGroup` > `ToggleGroupItem` children; our port has no separate `ToggleGroupItem` tag — each item is either a plain object (`{ value, label, disabled? }`) in `items=`, or a `<@item value="...">` attribute tag whose body becomes the item's rendered content. Attribute tags win if both are supplied on the same `ToggleGroup`.
